en: [FIRM NAME] provides financial investigation, forensic analysis, asset tracing, and case-support services. No recovery of funds or assets, legal outcome, or specific result is guaranteed. No representative of our legal or investigative team will request your passwords, private keys, seed phrases, authentication codes, bank or cryptocurrency account access, or direct payment to a personal account. Never share confidential credentials or transfer funds to anyone claiming to represent [FIRM NAME] without first verifying the request through our official contact channels.

Ne partagez jamais d’identifiants confidentiels et ne transférez jamais de fonds à une personne affirmant représenter [FIRM NAME] sans avoir préalablement vérifié la demande par nos canaux de contact officiels.
